gloss_en: Why do some MEP components come out grey in IFC while others keep colours?
title_original: whats the root cause of grey MEP-components in IFC
question_paraphrase: some pipes/ducts are grey in the exported IFC, others coloured; is the MVD (2x2 Coordination View) unable to carry system colours?
answer_summary: Colours from view filters/graphic overrides are view-specific and not exported; set colour on the Material itself, update exporter, use 2x3 CV2.0 or IFC4 RV.

gloss_en: Same family, type and material but exported in different colours
title_original: Element material colour/ color wrongly exported
question_paraphrase: elements with identical family/type/material get different colours in the IFC; carried over from the old SourceForge forum
answer_summary: Not reproducible in Revit 2023, reproducible in Revit 2018; closed as legacy material handling.

gloss_en: Pipes export the system material (e.g. SEWER) instead of real material (PVC, copper)
title_original: Pipes / ducts / etc export using system material not actual material
question_paraphrase: how to export the element's real material instead of the MEP system material?
answer_summary: Exporter uses system material by design; proposal to use system material as style and real material as IfcMaterial; Jira ticket open.

gloss_en: Export IFC with the colours of the current Revit view (filters/overrides)
title_original: ENH: Support for Export Current View Colors
question_paraphrase: want rebar coloured by diameter or rooms by colour scheme in the IFC as they appear in the view
answer_summary: Not supported; Autodesk says IFC is for classified geometry; workaround: DirectShapes with materials; Jira open.

gloss_en: Multi-layer walls/floors show no useful material pset in IFC4 RV
title_original: Material pset Wall/Floors with several material layers not exported IFC4
question_paraphrase: Solibri shows no Material pset, SimpleBIM one row with combined name for layered walls on IFC4 Reference View
answer_summary: Exporter writes IfcMaterialConstituentSet in RV and layer widths in Qto; viewers differ (BIMcollab Zoom fails); DTV/IFC4x3 give layer sets.

gloss_en: Export a custom sandwich wall family with several materials as separate layers
title_original: INQ: Revit family with more than one material layer
question_paraphrase: only one material is output as material layer for a structural framing family mapped to IfcWall
answer_summary: No workaround given; Jira REVIT-245284 open; only one layer, chosen arbitrarily.

gloss_en: Colour exported IFC rebars by a parameter

question_paraphrase: all IfcReinforcingBar share one material/colour so rebar groups are indistinguishable in viewers
answer_summary: Open wish; Jira story exists; related to #731.

gloss_en: Fittings export wrong material/colour

answer_summary: web-ifc 0.0.75 fixed part; remaining missing colours attributed to IFC4 export.

gloss_en: Walls typed by a material-styled type render white
title_original: [Bug]: Material colour assigned to an element type is not applied to its occurrences
question_paraphrase: material with IfcSurfaceStyle assigned only to the wall type: occurrences get white colour
answer_summary: Geometry processor ignored IfcRelDefinesByType material; fixed via fallback to type material.

gloss_en: Appending a wall occurrence loses the material colour
title_original: project.append_asset drops material surface styles when the material is reached via IfcMaterialLayerSetUsage
question_paraphrase: after append_asset the layered wall's materials have no IfcSurfaceStyle, so colour is lost
answer_summary: Cause: matched existing layer set skips check_inverses so HasRepresentation not copied; fix PR #8663 proposed.

gloss_en: Element renders default grey when material has body style plus section fill style

answer_summary: Open; suggest preferring MODEL_VIEW/Body context or first mappable surface style.

answer_summary: Layers live in IFC material layer set; only shown in cuts; APPLY_LAYERSETS slicing experimental; CSS maps material names to SVG hatches.

question_paraphrase: IFCSTYLEDITEM on a proxy mass: Solibri shows colour not transparency, ArchiCAD neither
answer_summary: Revit shows neither; Solibri colour only; BlenderBIM/FreeCAD OK; shape style beats material style per agreement CV-2x3-131.

answer_summary: No direct answer; Revit colour/material export is a known weakness; asks for the file.

gloss_en: Colours from Allplan lost in Revit, Autodesk Architecture and BricsCAD
title_original: Where and how will my colors be saved in IFC?
question_paraphrase: pipe-diameter colours exported from Allplan disappear in other apps but show in a viewer
answer_summary: Material is only a name; colour needs IfcSurfaceStyle via styled representation; Allplan attached style to the shape; 428 duplicate materials.

gloss_en: Inventory of how colours and textures are represented and supported
title_original: IFC Textures and Colors: Current Situation
question_paraphrase: overview of IfcSurfaceStyleShading, Rendering, textures and five assignment techniques
answer_summary: Shading RGBA best supported; textures/lighting almost unsupported; layer/profile colours hard.

gloss_en: RV drops material layers
title_original: Why are material layer sets excluded from IFC4 Reference View MVD?
question_paraphrase: layer information is fundamental but RV prefers constituent sets, so vendors do not deliver layers
answer_summary: Layer sets only fit standard walls; use constituent sets with shape aspects or complex quantities; DTV still draft.

gloss_en: Do same-named presentation layers form one layer or two?
title_original: How does multiple IfcPresentationLayerAssignment with the same name work?
question_paraphrase: two IfcPresentationLayerAssignment with same Name but different items: one layer or two?
answer_summary: No uniqueness rule; treat as separate layers (debated).

gloss_en: Which IFC material entity to use for a full material list
title_original: IFC materials
question_paraphrase: non-expert wants a list of materials across IFC files but sees many entities
answer_summary: IfcMaterial base; layer sets for planar, profile sets for beams/columns, constituents for complex objects; RV lists only constituent/set/single.

gloss_en: Extract materials and colours with Xbim; some elements return No Material
title_original: Retrieve materials and colors
question_paraphrase: code checks direct, type and styled-item sources but some elements still show No Material
answer_summary: Materials can be per representation item and assigned in many ways; use buildingSMART docs and Xbim.IDS.Validator pattern.
